name: Map
author: HamDash
description: Where you are and who you are working, with layers

basemap.label: Base map
basemap.help: Built-in needs no network and no account, and is the only one that works in a shack with no internet. The tile options need a connection.

borders.label: Country borders
borders.help: Drawn on the built-in base map. Tile base maps bring their own.

subdivisions.label: States and provinces
subdivisions.help: Internal boundaries, on the built-in base map. Natural Earth publishes these for Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, India, Indonesia, Russia, South Africa and the United States; elsewhere there is nothing to draw.

projection.label: Projection
projection.help: Azimuthal puts you in the middle and makes every bearing a straight line out from your station, which is what a beam heading is. It only works with the built-in base map: no tile service publishes tiles in that projection.

tile_url.label: Custom tile URL
tile_url.help: Only for 'custom tiles'. A template like https://tile.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=YOURKEY. Use your own provider and key: OpenStreetMap's own tiles are not meant for heavy use by applications.

tile_attribution.label: Custom tile credit
tile_attribution.help: Shown in the map corner. Most providers require this.

great_circle.label: Draw the path
great_circle.help: The short-path great circle, which is the way the signal goes, not a straight line on the map.

greyline.label: Greyline
greyline.help: The day/night terminator, worked out locally from the sun's position. No network needed.

aurora.label: Aurora
aurora.help: NOAA's OVATION forecast, refreshed about every five minutes. Needs a connection.

zoom.label: Framing
zoom.help: Fit keeps both stations in view. Either way, moving the map yourself takes over until you press the reset button.

owm_key.label: OpenWeatherMap key
owm_key.help: Only needed for the cloud layer. Free tier is plenty. Without a key the cloud layer is hidden rather than broken.
